svg.title: Lomuto partition
svg.text: Partition a[lo..hi] around the last element. One left-to-right scan; i grows the “smaller than pivot” prefix.

g.text: Pivot = a[hi] = 5. i marks where the next small element goes.
a[1] = 2 < 5: swap it into slot 0, then i → 1.
a[3] = 4 < 5: swap it into slot 1, then i → 2.
a[4] = 3 < 5: swap it into slot 2, then i → 3.
Loop over. Swap the pivot into slot 3: everything left of it is smaller, everything right of
